groups.activity: complete The New War, then Veilbreaker

rows.label: Veilbreaker
rows.note: unlocks Kahl's Garrison at Rank 1 Shelter

conditions: Start the chain early so the weekly clock is already running when you want the gun.

rows.label: Stock
rows.alt: repeatable Stock crates, 2 each, up to 5 per run

conditions: Finishing the mission itself pays no Stock; only the six bonus challenges do, 30 for Deathless and 15 for each of the others.
The missions rotate Sneaky Sabotage, Junk Run and Prison Break, resetting Monday 00:00 UTC. A skipped week delays Rank 5 by a week.
Crate Stock needs extraction. Challenge Stock pays the moment a challenge completes and survives an abort.
Prison Break has points of no return: collect earlier rooms before boarding the Bolkor, and passwords behind rubble before killing the Wolf.
bonuses: Split a timed challenge from the collectible hunts into two runs; challenge progress carries between runs.
You only need 60 Stock, so skip the most annoying challenge in a bad week.
Hellions veilbroken mid-flight keep their homing Grakata and help with kill challenges.

disclosures.title: Styanax from the same shop
disclosures.body: Chipper sells Styanax's four blueprints at Ranks 2-5 for 270 Stock. At 105 a week, both the frame and the Afentis fit in the same four weeks.

conditions: Chipper's shop shows your Garrison rank; the Syndicate terminal does not.

rows.label: Afentis
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 8,000 Ferrite, 3,500 Rubedo, 1,200 Cryotic, 2 Argon Crystal

conditions: Afentis Prime is a separate Mastery item from Void relics; owning it doesn't cover this one.
